description: Service public d'eau potable de la Métropole de Lyon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. This dataset provides the key annual information on drinking water in the Metropolis, so it has been possible to find the following information since 2009: number of inhabitants served, price per m3, yield, volumes, subscribers, meters, etc. Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "Public drinking water service of the Métropole de Lyon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole de Lyon. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
